page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred text block of dedication lines, no running head, no page number. A library stamp at the foot (not transcribed). A handwritten mark at top left (not transcribed).
page.notes: The date line "CID IO XCVIL" is printed with reversed-C numerals; per the rules it should read MDXCVII (1597), transcribed here as printed. The stamp of the Stadtbibliothek Zürich at the foot and the handwritten mark at top left are not transcribed. The Greek words HOMONOEAS and PHILALETHIAS are printed in Latin letters in this line as shown; the line is set in capitals and the first letters are uncertain [?].
